scenarios.title: Vague picnic bake: questions, options, select, plan, technique question
scenarios.request: We're having a family picnic on Sunday and I'd like to bake something to bring. What do you suggest?

scripted_answers.answer: About 10 people, adults and kids. I have an oven.
No restrictions. It needs to travel well without a fridge.

scenarios.followup_message: How long can it safely sit out at the picnic?
